# OpenCodeReview

> OpenCodeReview is a self-hosted, source-available AI code reviewer for GitHub pull requests. It reviews every pull request with the Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode CLI, signed in with the Claude, ChatGPT or Google account you already have, or with OpenCode's free models, and posts the findings on the pull request. It is built for indie hackers and solo SaaS builders who have nobody else to review their code.

- Runs on your own machine or server with one Docker command: `git clone https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview && cd opencodereview && docker compose up --build`, then open http://localhost:1421.
- Free for individuals and companies of any size, including commercial use, under the Functional Source License 1.1 (FSL-1.1-ALv2). The only restriction is selling it as a competing product or service; each version becomes Apache 2.0 two years after release.
- There is no OpenCodeReview account and no per-seat price. The only cost is the AI plan you already pay for.
- Your code stays on the machine that runs OpenCodeReview; reviews call your AI provider with your own sign-in or key.
- Supported plans: Claude Pro, Max or Team (Claude Code), ChatGPT plans that include Codex, a Google account (Gemini CLI), OpenCode free models or an OpenCode Go key. Local models are not supported.
- Several accounts can be connected; when one hits its usage limit, the review continues on the next.
- Compared with hosted reviewers such as CodeRabbit or Greptile, which are billed per developer and run your code in their cloud, OpenCodeReview is self-hosted and uses the AI plan you already have.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/README.md): features, quick start and requirements
- [Pull request reviews](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/reviews.md): when a review starts, scope, context, validation and how results are published on GitHub
- [Configuration](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): settings, environment variables, remote access and ports
- [Architecture](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): services, isolated review runners, account failover and credentials
- [Repository indexing](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/indexing.md): packages, imports and symbols given to each review
- [Review skills](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/skills.md): the editable Markdown methodology reviews follow
- [Upgrading](https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview/blob/main/docs/upgrading.md): moving between versions and running on your own Postgres
